fines.litigation: an ICO monetary penalty notice under DPA 2018 s155 is the penalty IMPOSED, not a notice of intent: the GBP 183,390,000 notice of intent of 2019 was reduced to this figure before it was issued. No adverse litigation about it is known to this repository, and NO tribunal or court register was read FOR THIS EXAMPLE. It prices, and every scenario it reaches says so -- a named could-not-look on the appeal, never a claim of finality (eco-system ticket 79 review F4: one rule for every regulator's concluding instrument, so the grading cannot track the pricing outcome).
